name: walk-start
js: (() => { { if (window.__wp) clearInterval(window.__wp); const app = window.__CITY_APP; const cm = app.controllerManager; const f = () => { const e = cm.entities[cm.activeMode]; console.log("[walkpos] " + cm.activeMode + " " + e.position.x.toFixed(1) + " " + e.position.y.toFixed(2) + " " + e.position.z.toFixed(1)); }; f(); window.__wp = setInterval(f, 2000); } })()
